parameters.label: Façade material
parameters.question: Which façade material?
parameters.explainer: The skin of the pavilion: its fins and panels.

parameters.label: Window ratio
parameters.question: How much of the wall is window?
parameters.explainer: Share of the façade that is glazing.

parameters.label: Roof angle
parameters.question: How steep is the roof?
parameters.explainer: Pitch of the mono-pitch roof. Steeper roofs overhang more.

parameters.label: Canopy depth
parameters.question: How deep is the entrance canopy?
parameters.explainer: How far the canopy reaches out over the entrance.
